node.statement: Single-projection estimate. Let S be either T_n or R_n and u_S=Co_{S,S}(S). From node 1.1, ||S||<=M and ||Co_{S,S}-L_S R_S||<=k*e. Since (L_S R_S)(S)=S(S^2), the epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms and ||S^2-S||<=delta give ||u_S-S||<=k*e*||S||+||S(S^2)-S||, while bilinearity gives S(S^2)-S=S(S^2-S)+(S^2-S), so ||u_S-S||<=[k*M+2*M+1]*e when e<=1.
